title: Hydrological Cycle
definition: The continuous circulation of water within the Earth-atmosphere system, driven by solar energy and gravity, involving phase changes among liquid, vapor, and ice.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to understanding physical geography, climate systems, monsoon mechanisms, water resource management, and environmental degradation issues in both Prelims (GS-1) and Mains (GS-1/GS-3).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Hydrological Cycle.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
